What We’re About

We Believe in Open Source

We’re a company founded by engineers with a passion for the open source community. That’s why we’re committed to enabling engineers to continue using the open source tools through an easy-to-use, open source-based observability platform that can easily scale based on their needs.

 
How We Work

Urgency. Alignment. Ownership.

All of our teammates strive to act urgently, own their work, and align with the company-wide efforts. You’ll find yourself immersed in a deeply collaborative environment with team members across the globe committed to enabling our customers and driving new innovations in open source observability.

Who We’re Looking For

Calling All Innovators

Regardless of department or position, everyone here is committed to finding new, innovative solutions to and driving customer success. And it’s not just talk. With hundreds of awards, thousands of customers, and, most recently, a spot on Gartner’s Magic Quadrant, we’re always looking for new talent to help push us, and the industry, forward.

How You Will Grow

Career Expansion at Logz.io

These socks were made for moving! It’s not about where you start, it’s where you end up. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to continue to grow your existing skill set or find a new one. Juno Journey access, mentorship programs, regular promotions and more are just a few of the opportunities you can take advantage to help you create the career path you want.

More Than a Job

Supporting Our Communities

At Logz.io, we’re committed to building and helping communities online and offline. With several community support activities and volunteer opportunities throughout the year, our employees have the opportunity to find community initiatives they are passionate about and jump in to help out. In addition, we host several charitable giving initiatives throughout the year to support charities and programs in our communities.
